title: Киндред [Объект 6244]
description:
The Board has chosen you for its newest experiment.Play as an up-and-coming Agent given the impossible task of delving into the mind of an unreadable beast. 

The chamber walls are cold and uninviting, one sole light illuminating the thing waiting inside.

Your heart beats loudly in the silence, an uncontrollable sign of your rising paranoia.

The unnerving presence of the monster fills you with honest,  unshakeable fear. 

How the next three days progress is entirely up to you: your methods of interrogation must be finely tuned and given purposeful direction.

Being unable to choose a side won't end well, so don't idle on the side lines. 

Interrogate Subject 6244.Your primary goal is extraction of as much information about this creature as possible.

Whether or not you're added to 6244's body count isn't always up to you, but your decisions matter.

Don't end up another casualty.

See you soon, Agent.
description_short: In this eerie, horror visual novel, you are confined in a room with a monster. How will you fare against petrifying odds? Will you be able to work your way into the mind of an indecipherable beast, or will you be added to the casualty count? A word of advice: Choose a side; don't look back.
